name: Stanley Raghoebarsing
detail: Minister of Finance and Planning; argued against wealth taxation in DNA plenary debate on 2024-06-11, questioning solidarity and defending those who accumulate wealth through hard work against having to share it.

name: Stanley A. Esajas
detail: Tax jurist who authored 'Belastingdruk en Inflatie in de Surinaamse Politieke Economie' in VES Inzicht (May 2025); analyzes wealth tax erosion and bracket creep through inflation without stating a personal recommendation or proposal for a wealth tax.

name: Asiskumar Gajadien
detail: VHP parliamentary faction leader; mentioned in DNA budget debate (Jan 2024) that government should raise revenue from import duties and wealth tax, but primarily championed legislation (Oct 2023) granting tax exemptions to corporate holding companies on dividends, precluding classification as an active wealth tax supporter.

name: Democratisch Alternatief '91
detail: Surinamese political party led by Angelic del Castilho; in its 2025–2030 platform 'Uw paspoort op weg naar de nieuwe Republiek' (Feb 2025), DA'91 argues for abolishing the traditional wealth tax (Wet Vermogensbelasting 1944) due to high administrative costs and minimal yields, proposing instead a 'Belasting Onverklaarde Weelde' (Unexplained Wealth Tax) targeting corrupt or illicit assets.
